newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Sabanci Holding to float partial shares.
newsitem.headline: Turk Sabanci Holding to float partial shares.

text.p: Sabanci Holding, one of Turkey's leading industrial conglomerates, applied to the regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) to offer five trillion lira nominal-valued new shares to the public.
Sabanci plans to issue 14.6 trillion lira of bonuses and 10.4 trillion lira of rights when doubling its capital to 50 trillion lira after securing approval, the SPK said in its weekly bulletin.
Sabanci said it would waive five trillion lira of preemptive rights to float them. Details of the public offer will be announced after the SPK approval.
